services.title: How we help
services.subtitle: We support administration, as well as businesses, civil society, and research, in working with open data to create added value together.

first.title: Support for data sharing
first.subtitle: This API allows targeted searches for datasets, catalogs, and vocabularies. It is comparable to the search function on the website – making it particularly useful when it is not yet clear which datasets should be retrieved or when an overview is needed.

second.title: Innovative Solutions
second.subtitle: This API does not allow direct searches but enables significantly more comprehensive queries. It allows querying datasets, catalogs, and vocabularies. Those who provide data to us can also use this API to edit or delete their own datasets, distributions, and catalogs.

third.title: Innovative Solutions
third.subtitle: Our metadata is stored in triple format in a graph database. We have set up an interface that allows direct queries of this data. Just as relational databases are queried using SQL, a graph database is queried using SPARQL.

interfaces.title: APIs
interfaces.subtitle2: APIs enable standardized and secure access to open data – for research, administration, and innovative applications.
interfaces.subtitle3: Use our open interfaces to develop your own applications, automate data analyses, or gain new insights into urban data.

first.subtitle: This API allows targeted searches for datasets, catalogs, and vocabularies. It is comparable to the search function on the website – making it particularly useful when it is not yet clear which datasets should be retrieved or when an overview is needed.

second.title: Complex operations via our Repo API

header.title: Legal Information and Data Protection
header.description: Welcome to our section for legal information and data protection. Here you will find all the essential details about our imprint, legal notices, and our privacy policy. These pages are designed to provide transparency about the operation of our website and to explain how we handle your personal data.

notice.heading: Legal Notice
notice.paragraph1: All rights reserved. Texts, images, graphics, sound, animations, and videos, as well as their arrangement on this website, are subject to copyright and other protection laws. The content of this website may not be copied, distributed, modified, or made accessible to third parties for commercial purposes.
notice.paragraph2: Our website may contain links to other providers' websites. Despite careful and regular checks, we do not assume any liability for the content of external links. We have no influence on the design and content of the sites we link to. If you want to visit such websites, you should observe the respective applicable notices. We are not responsible for the privacy standards and practices of other providers. If you become aware of illegal content or practices of external links, we kindly ask you to inform us immediately.
notice.paragraph3: Furthermore, we use Google Analytics, a web analysis service from Google. Google Analytics uses cookies (small text files) that are stored on your computer and enable an analysis of your use of the website. The information generated by the cookie about your use of this website (including your IP address) will be transmitted to and stored by a Google server in the USA. Google will use this information to evaluate your use of the website, compile reports on website activity for website operators, and provide other services relating to website and internet usage. Google may also transfer this information to third parties if required by law or if third parties process this data on behalf of Google. Under no circumstances will Google associate your IP address with other data held by Google. You can prevent the installation of cookies by adjusting your browser software settings; however, we must inform you that in this case, you may not be able to use all the functionalities of this website. By using our website, you consent to the processing of data collected about you by Google in the manner and for the purposes described above.

DKSRAppsView.subtitle: Here you can find use case-specific data analysis tools

heatwaves.title: Understanding Heatwaves
heatwaves.content: Heatwaves are dangerously hot periods that increase health risks. Understanding their severity factors helps planners and citizens improve urban heat resilience and reduce casualties.

bikePlanner.title: Bike Lane Planner
bikePlanner.content: This experimental tool could help city planners quickly test various strategies for placing new bike lanes.

heatActions.title: Planning Heatwave Actions
heatActions.content: Cities face the risk of heatwaves and must invest in new infrastructure. Our tool organizes data to simplify decision-making and explore solutions.

heatRisk.title: Heatwave Risk Areas
heatRisk.content: Cities face the risk of heatwaves and must invest in new infrastructure. Our tool organizes data to simplify decision-making and explore solutions.

heatRiskWeighted.title: Heat risk analysis
heatRiskWeighted.content: Health risks to heat don't arise solely from high air temperatures—they interact with other environmental and personal factors such as radiant temperature, cooling potential, activity level, age, etc. The vulnerability of individual population groups also plays a key role. This analysis tool makes the relevant factors more tangible and helps identify neighborhoods where measures are most needed.

solarTool.title: Understanding solar potential
solarTool.content: With VC Solar, sustainable planning is possible by determining and evaluating the solar potential of buildings and open spaces in 3D. The solution takes shading into account, calculates yields, and makes solar data directly usable within the digital city model.

heatRiskAnalysis.title: Heat Risk Analysis
heatRiskAnalysis.content: The heat risk filter allows particularly heat-vulnerable areas in the city to be identified. By defining groups in need of assistance, cooling measures can be planned in a targeted way.

digitalEnergyAdvisor.title: Digital Energy Advisor
digitalEnergyAdvisor.content: The digital energy advisor can be used by citizens or property managers to obtain information about the energy optimization potential of their residential building. By sharing the data with the municipality, local heat planning is supported.

smartWinterService.title: Smart Winter Service
smartWinterService.content: Real-time control of winter service operations based on integrated weather, sensor, and vehicle data — for efficient resource planning, liability documentation, and transparent citizen communication

schoolDistrictPlanning.title: School District Planning
schoolDistrictPlanning.content: Data-driven definition of primary school districts using isochrone analyses, automated capacity monitoring, and an early warning system for threshold exceedances.

economyMonitoring.title: Economy Monitoring
economyMonitoring.content: Economic and business indicators as well as location analysis for residents and investments

socialMonitoring.title: Social Monitoring & Public Services Atlas
socialMonitoring.content: Dashboard-based overview of social infrastructure (daycare centers, schools, doctors, care places), demographic indicators, spatial supply analysis, simplified planning, and efficient reporting for mandatory reports

drafts.intro:
This page provides a comprehensive interface for the effective management of your dataset drafts.

You can download your datasets in various formats to ensure compatibility with different data analysis tools and platforms. Whether you need JSON-LD, RDF/XML, Turtle, NOTATION3 or N-Triples, this page enables you to easily access and download your data.

Editing drafts is straightforward; simply select a draft to modify its content. This feature allows you to update and refine your datasets to ensure they meet your requirements and standards.

If you need to create variations or backup copies of your dataset drafts, the duplication function allows you to effortlessly create copies. This can be useful for testing different data scenarios or preserving original versions before making major changes.

For drafts that are no longer needed or relevant, the delete option helps keep your workspace organized by removing unnecessary drafts. Manage your dataset drafts efficiently and keep your data management process smooth with the tools provided on this page.
